profile.headline: Software engineer searching for a new position
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
As a Lead Software Engineer at NAMU-ai, I architected and led the development of Layover by Naropass, a travel app that connects travel industry professionals, using React and Typescript on the front end, NextJS on the back end, and the CapacitorJS framework for app compilation.

I also implemented Firebase for authentication and NoSQL for data management, and utilized various APIs such as Ably, Bing, and Twilio, to enable real-time communication, location tracking, and SMS notifications. I streamlined the deployment process with Github Actions and Vercel, resulting in a highly robust, distributed, and scalable platform capable of supporting thousands of users at minimal operating costs. I lead a team of four in creating, designing, maintaining, and improving the platform, organizing sprints and prioritizing development goals. I collaborate with internal teams to translate business needs into technical requirements and deliver high-quality products that meet user expectations and industry standards.

I graduated from Berklee College of Music with a Bachelor of Music in Performance (Voice) in 2016, and I have a strong background in computer science and broadcast journalism from the University of Maryland. I have over five years of experience in server-side and backend development, with expertise in NextJS, Typescript, NodeJS, PHP, React, NoSQL, MSSQL, Postgres, and Redis. I am always excited to work on new projects and learn new skills, and I welcome any opportunity to connect with other professionals and enthusiasts in the field. Feel free to contact me if you want to chat about music, technology, or anything in between.

positions.title: Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
• Partner with diverse clients to design, architect, and deliver end-to-end software solutions, from mobile applications (React Native) to scalable backend systems (Node.js, Nest.js, Python).
• Manage the full project lifecycle, including technical specification, development, deployment, and maintenance, ensuring alignment with client business goals.
• Specialize in modern web technologies including React, Next.js, and Ruby on Rails to build high-performance, responsive applications.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the end-to-end architecture and development of the "Layover by Naropass" travel app, leading a team of 4 engineers through the full product lifecycle from concept to deployment.
• Engineered a scalable and cost-effective platform using a modern tech stack (Next.js, React, TypeScript) and CapacitorJS for cross-platform native builds
• Implemented a robust CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions and Vercel, enabling rapid iteration and ensuring high uptime for thousands of active users while minimizing operational costs
• Developed core backend services using Firebase for user authentication and NoSQL data management, and integrated third-party APIs (Ably, Bing, Twilio) to expand application functionality.
• Acted as the key technical liaison, collaborating with product and design teams to translate business requirements into actionable development roadmaps and prioritize features for Agile sprints.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · React.js · Sprint Planning · Node.js · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Express.js

Streamlined operations by monitoring KPIs and implementing new software tools to increase process automation and reduce required manual input, reducing billing staff costs by 50%

positions.title: Broadcast Journalist
positions.description:
Work as a journalist on the Business Daily news program.

Wrote B-roll VOs for the anchor and wrote and recorded packages in English from both Korean and English sources.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed as a key member of an 8-person engineering team to enhance Wayfair’s B2B e-commerce platform, developing full-stack features using PHP, MSSQL, and JavaScript.
• Engineered an automated B2B account approval system by integrating a third-party SOAP API, significantly reducing manual processing and accelerating the client onboarding workflow.
• Designed and implemented a customer segmentation feature that analyzed user data to create tailored B2B verticals, personalizing product recommendations and discounts to improve user experience.
• Operated within an enterprise-level CI/CD environment using Jenkins for automated builds and deployments, and utilized monitoring tools like Elasticsearch and Grafana to ensure system health.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · PHP · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
